content:
sara.k: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for inference-api-frontend 5xx spike in us-east-1 — automatic escalation to on-call.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-01, priority: P1. Owner: unassigned. War room: https://meet.prod/warroom/INC-2026-0423-01
sara.k: I'm going to start the war room. @dmitri.m can you take owner if you're available? I need someone to lead triage and customer comms.
dmitri.m: I'm on call and taking owner. joining war room now. Confirming I'm available to handle customer comm draft and coordinate mitigation.
maya: Joining war room. Will look at routing nodes and LB health in parallel. ping me if you need autoscale adjustments.
leo: I'll gather recent deploys and metric diffs, also check KV cache telemetry for spikes.
incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by dmitri.m at 2026-04-23T15:12:46Z. On-call rota: dmitri.m, next: maya.
sara.k: Quick status for the thread: impact appears to be increased 5xx on /v1/generate during peak tails, affecting ~18% of requests in us-east-1. No reports yet from EU/APAC.
dmitri.m: Confirmed. Initial hypothesis: routing layer dropping keep-alive to backend pool after a recent config flip. Mitigation plan: 1) increase LB retry window, 2) roll back config flip on subset of nodes, 3) enable degraded routing to fallback model variant.
maya: Tests show a surge of 503s correlating with LB config rollout 6m ago. Rolling back config on 3/5 hosts now.
leo: Noted deployment ID: deploy-2026-04-23-1127. Reverting that subset will take ~2-3m. Patching healthcheck backoff while rollback proceeds.
dmitri.m: OK executing rollback on canary hosts. @sara.k can you start a short status page update? Keep it concise, customer-facing: what happened, who's working it, ETA for next update.
sara.k: Drafting status page — dropping into thread for review:

```
Summary: We are investigating increased errors (5xx/503) affecting text generation requests in us-east-1.
Impact: Some requests may fail with 5xx; retries may succeed. Not all customers are affected.
Root cause: Under investigation; a recent load balancer configuration rollout is suspected.
Mitigation: Rolling back the recent LB config on a subset of hosts and enabling fallback routing to reduce failures.
Next update: 15 minutes.
Contact: support@redwood.ai for urgent account-level concerns.
```

Please suggest edits.
dmitri.m: Good. Add: "Customers may see higher latency during rollback; no data loss expected." then publish.
sara.k: Updated and publishing to status.redwood.ai — done. Status page link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0423-01 (published)
incident-bot: Status page updated by sara.k at 2026-04-23T15:15:02Z.
maya: Rollback completed on canary hosts — 503 rate dropped to ~4% on those. Rolling out remaining hosts now with staggered windows.
leo: Observability: token-level latency spike normalized on canaries. KV-cache retries decreased. Good sign.
dmitri.m: Can someone prepare a short customer notification template for accounts over 1M tokens/day? We'll send targeted emails after stabilization.
sara.k: Draft customer notify:

"We experienced elevated 5xx errors for text generation in us-east-1 starting at 15:06 UTC. Our on-call team identified a configuration change and has rolled back the change; remediation is underway. You may see some request retries or higher latency while we finish recovery. We'll follow up when all regions are healthy. If you have a critical SLA concern, reply to this email or open a ticket. — Redwood Inference Ops"

Thoughts?
dmitri.m: Good. Add a line with a support-level contact phone for enterprise customers. Then queue send for impacted accounts only.
sara.k: Added contact and queued targeted email to account ops. ETA for full recovery: monitoring until error rate <1% for 10m. Next internal update in 10m.
leo: Adding post-incident follow-up checklist to thread: reproduce windows, annotate deploy pipeline, add LB rollout guard (canary auto-rollback), and run a traffic replay to validate.
incident-bot: Pager resolved: automated rollback completed at 2026-04-23T15:23:10Z. Monitoring phase initiated.
dmitri.m: Thanks team. I'll keep war room open for 30m to monitor and then convert to RCA follow-up channel. Closing customer comms loop after 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
maya: Monitoring healthy on all hosts. Leaving note in incident doc for next steps.
sara.k: Great job — marking initial comms done. I'll draft status page final update when we hit stabilization.
